channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: UAE intercepts 113 unmanned aerial vehicles and 16 ballistic missiles
item.description: The United Arab Emirates said its air defence systems intercepted 113 UAVs and 16 of 17 ballistic missiles during Iranian attacks. One missile fell into the sea, while four drones landed within the country. Since the start of the attacks, 238 ballistic missiles have been detected — 221 destroyed.

item.title: India vs NZ final: MS Dhoni–Rohit Sharma lift WC trophy together, bring it to ground; Ricky Martin, Sukhbir, Falguni Pathak perform
item.description: The ICC Men's T20 World Cup Final at the Narendra Modi Stadium began with a delightful closing ceremony featuring celebs Falguni Pathak, Sukhbir Singh and Ricky Martin. Their performances added a dash of glamour to the cricketing spectacle.

item.title: Fake news on attack on Kashmiri students in Iran sparks panic in J&K
item.description: Rumours circulating on social media about the alleged killing of a Kashmiri student in Iran have been debunked as fake by the Jammu and Kashmir Students Association. The organisation said all Indian students, including those from Kashmir, are safe despite the tense situation in parts of Iran due to the ongoing conflict.

item.title: Visually-impaired Irfan Lone clears UPSC; brings laurels to Kashmir
item.description: Irfan Ahmad Lone, a visually impaired youth from Mirpora village in Bandipora, has cleared the UPSC Civil Services Examination, securing All India Rank 957 and inspiring people across Kashmir. The son of a daily-wage labourer, Irfan lost his eyesight in childhood due to accidents but overcame immense challenges to pursue higher education and achieve his dream.

item.title: India processing Russian oil is pragmatic decision: US
item.description: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright called India's decision to process Russian crude a "pragmatic move" to stabilize Asian energy supplies amid geopolitical disruptions. He clarified that the policy does not alter US sanctions on Russia but helps move stranded crude in Asian waters to refineries in India.

item.title: New video contradicts US claims on Iran school strike
item.description: A new video suggests a US Tomahawk missile hit an Iranian naval facility near Minab's Shajarah Tayyebeh school, reportedly killing 175 civilians. While Trump denied targeting the school, US forces confirmed strikes along Iran's southern coast amid rising tensions near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices unlikely to be raised in near term amid supply disruption
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices in India are likely to remain unchanged despite crude crossing $110 amid Middle East tensions. The government expects OMCs to absorb the impact, while India boosts energy stocks and diversifies imports to reduce reliance on the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty 50 plunge nearly 3% as crude oil nears $110 amid US–Iran conflict 2026
item.description: As of 9.22 AM, the Sensex lost 2,333 points, or 2.96 per cent, to reach 76,585 and Nifty dipped 686 points, or 2.81 per cent to reach 23,764.

item.title: Nita Ambani makes Aishwarya Rai, Abhishek Bachchan dance to Salman Khan's song; Aaradhya poses with Orry
item.description: Nita Ambani, Aishwarya Rai and Abhishek Bachchan danced at Mudit Dani's wedding. The couple also posed with Orry during the wedding festivities. Mudit is Mukesh Ambani's nephew. The four-day celebrations took place between the Jio World Convention Centre and Trident, Nariman Point.

item.title: India wins T20 WC: Hardik Pandya, GF Mahieka kiss passionately; Ishan Kishan kisses GF Aditi; SRK, PM Modi, Virat-Anushka rejoice
item.description: India clinched a record third T20 World Cup title on Sunday, powered by a blazing 89 from Sanju Samson. PM Modi, Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma, among others, congratulated the team. While on the field, Hardik and his GF Mahieka couldn't stop kissing, and Ishan too kissed his GF Aditi during the celebrations.
